recall.minute: Prefill processes the prompt in parallel (compute-bound), fills the KV cache, and determines time to first token. Decode generates one token per step (bandwidth-bound; time per output token), attending to cached K/V. Greedy picks argmax (myopic: A z 0.24 vs beam's B x 0.36). Beam search keeps B sequences; good for translation, bland for open text. Top-k samples from the k best (k = 2 on 0.5/0.25/0.15/0.10 → 0.667/0.333). Top-p keeps the smallest set reaching p (0.9 → 3 tokens, renormalised 0.556/0.278/0.167). Temperature: softmax(z/T); T = 0.5 → top 0.725, T = 2 → 0.37. Decode reads all weights per step: 7B × 2 B = 14 GB at 2 TB/s → 7 ms → ≤ 143 tok/s; batching and quantization help. KV cache per token = 2 × L × d × bytes = 524,288 B for 32 × 4096 × 16-bit; 2048 tokens ≈ 1 GiB. MQA (1 K/V head, 32× smaller), GQA (8 groups, 4×), MLA (latent, ~16×) shrink it.
